in_sanskrit.name: परिजात
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Parijat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'parijat' which means 'fruit of the heavenly tree' or 'boon-giving tree'. This name is associated with the mythological Parijat tree, which is believed to bear the celestial fruit that grants immortality and eternal happiness.

in_hindi.name: परिजात

in_marathi.name: Parijat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heavenly Fruit Tree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parijat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parijat is a Sanskrit name derived from the Parijat tree. It is believed that the tree bears flowers which never fade and is a symbol of eternal life. In Hindu mythology, the Parijat tree is said to be located at the gates of Amaravati, the celestial city, and is tended by the gods themselves.
